customManagers.description: The Renovate image the validator runs, written as a docker run argument in ci.yml and the justfile, where no default manager reads it. Both copies move in one PR.

packageRules.description: The validator image is upgraded by the regex manager above, so it is a custom.regex upgrade. The preset's ci: rules reach the github-actions manager and only the custom.regex depNames they list, and this image is neither, so without this rule its commits lose the ci: prefix.
